import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'.')
from helpers import *
y=np.load('base_feats.npz')['y']; folds=np.load('folds.npy')
h12=np.concatenate([np.load('pass_3/cls_hidden_L12.npy'),np.load('pass_4/cls_hidden_L12.npy')]).astype(np.float64)
pooled=np.concatenate([np.load('pass_3/pooled.npy'),np.load('pass_4/pooled.npy')]).astype(np.float64)
Ln=np.load('LN_est_v1.npy')
err=np.abs(h12-Ln); print('max abs diff vs predicted', err.max(), 'mean', err.mean())
print('pooled range', pooled.min(), pooled.max(), np.abs(pooled).mean())
np.save('v1_pooled.npy',pooled.astype(np.float32))
for a in [0.05,0.1,0.2,0.4]:
    acc,pred=cv(pooled,y,folds,lda_fit,a); print('lda',a,round(acc,4),round(macro_f1(y,pred),4))
for l in [10,30,100,300]:
    acc,pred=cv(pooled,y,folds,ridge_fit,l); print('ridge',l,round(acc,4),round(macro_f1(y,pred),4))
